title: Exotic Sweet Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A sweet and savory Moroccan dish featuring chicken, cheese, and corn flour, perfect for a keto-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together corn flour, cumin, paprika, and a pinch of salt
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the corn flour mixture
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute
Add the coated chicken to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven
Bake for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the crumbled feta cheese
